text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hussein and King Fahd discuss bilateral ties and activating joint Arab efforts during the king's short visit to Saudi Arabia to perform a minor pilgrimage, both leaders stress importance of maintaining ties between Arabs and consolidating understanding and cooperation.
- Saudi Foreign Minister visits Amman after the Moslem feast of Eid al-Fitr to follow-up on consolidating ties.
- Communications Minister says his ministry ready to facilitate new phone lines to commercial users.
- Jordanian-Saudi accord to activate economic and political ties at the conclusion of King Hussein's visit to Saudi Arabia.
- Lebanon rejects Jordanian complaints over the release of the Iraqi diplomats who had been detained over the killing of an Iraqi opposition figure who holds an Jordanian passport.
- Editor of Abed Rabbo weekly detained on charges of slander, two others convicted amid mounting controversy over tabloids ethics.
